name: homelab-forge
description: Portfolio-grade home software forge on Ubuntu + Nix
install: # Verify Nix is available (should be pre-installed on localpower)
command -v nix-shell || (echo 'Nix not found; install from https://nixos.org/download' && exit 1)
# Install/update Home Manager profile (user tools: gh, kubectl, vault, etc.)
cd nix && nix run nixpkgs#home-manager -- switch --flake .#diestrin
command -v gh || echo 'Warning: gh (GitHub CLI) not found'
command -v kubectl || echo 'Warning: kubectl not found'
command -v vault || echo 'Warning: vault not found'
command -v forge || echo 'Warning: forge CLI not found'
start: # Verify k3s is running (localpower should have k3s cluster)
systemctl is-active --quiet k3s 2>/dev/null || echo 'Warning: k3s not running'
vault status 2>/dev/null || echo 'Warning: Vault not accessible (may need port-forward: kubectl -n forge-system port-forward svc/vault 8200:8200)'
